brock_yokley: Clement "Saint" Yokley was a tailor in Esterhaus until the posters went up. He came to R-F11 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole bay knew that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Clement "Saint" Yokley was number 35. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Clement "Saint" Yokley folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Clement "Saint" Yokley raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal of the Hegemony (@hodnepijumaloctu).
ebrrrvole: Jakub Ebrrrvole signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Jakub Ebrrrvole was number 65. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Jakub Ebrrrvole received a photograph taken outside the family home. He studied the unfamiliar curtains longer than the faces. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F15. Jakub Ebrrrvole has learned to walk bent double.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub Ebrrrvole went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
jackmdunn06: Isidor Jackmdunn came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Isidor Jackmdunn was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Isidor Jackmdunn asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Isidor Jackmdunn counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Isidor Jackmdunn shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Jackmdunn fired at a movement across the wire at S-F11. The man went down: Edmund Somosmagios, badly wounded.
jakub.prokes: After 3 days of war, S-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin Prokes.
wolfmanantony: Nils Wolfmananton came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
A bullet went through Nils Wolfmananton's sleeve at S-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

The medics cleaned Nils Wolfmananton's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton has learned to walk bent double.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton was the only one they could still help, and only just. Nils Wolfmananton died in the hospital bed despite everything the surgeon tried. a rosary of rough beads was in his hand at the end.
Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton arrived carrying the family name of Nils Wolfmananton. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
